items.title: Palantir (PLTR) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Strong Q2 And Raised Guidance
items.summary: Palantir Technologies is back in focus as fresh research lifts fair value estimates from US$185.70 to US$191.68, while price targets in recent reports cluster in a higher US$200 to US$245 range. Analysts are updating these targets after what they describe as an exceptional Q2 2026 report, stronger AI related demand, and new guidance that has split opinion on how much upside is still left. Read on to see how this evolving narrative could shape the way you think about Palantir Technologies from...

items.title: 3 Reasons PLTR Has Explosive Upside Potential
items.summary: Palantir Technologies currently trades at $182.42 and has been a dream stock for shareholders. It’s returned 583% since September 2021, blowing past the S&P 500’s 69.5% gain. The company has also beaten the index over the past six months as its stock price is up 19.1% thanks to its solid quarterly results.
